question: What happens to that power when contraction is dissolved?
premises: A practitioner may be intent on dissolving it.
When contraction dissolves, the power manifests freely.
inference: Therefore, for one intent on dissolving contraction, that power becomes radiant and brings about the inner appearance of whatever is desired.
plain_english: Likewise, for one who is intent on dissolving the whole mass of contraction, that power becomes radiant and can bring about the inner appearance of whatever is desired.
